name: zeffect_anim_runtime_sequence_group
description: zEffect animation runtime activation, sequence dispatch, surface/transform-ref event dispatch, and stop/finalize callbacks behave as one source dependency group.
known_limits: The runtime activation, sequence, and stop/finalize functions are mutually dependent through callbacks and event dispatch; tier S verification should be attempted as a coherent zEffect animation source-cluster pass, not as isolated functions.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja frontier reports show the cycle through ActivateRuntime, StopAndCleanup, Stop, FinalizeStop, RunStopDelayCallback, NodeActionCallback, RunSequenceEvents, RunSequence, and event handlers that reactivate child animations.

The native group smoke verifies ActivateRuntime installs the runtime callback, SetVelocity/SetPositionRefAndVelocity/SetTransformRefs/SetTransformRotAndVelocity initialize active entries and activation records where valid, RunSequenceEvents advances a no-op event stream, RunSequence completes a sequence and invokes the done callback, HandleSurfaceRefEvent and HandleTransformRefsEvent cache child entries, named stop/emitter play dispatch into the stop path, and the stop-delay callback finalizes cleanup.
